subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this composite issue remain open as the umbrella for both Control UI structured reply metadata and no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split and close it against the narrower canonical items?
rationale: Current main is partial, and the remaining behavior changes protocol/runtime/session semantics rather than a narrow file-level repair; automation cannot choose the permanent contract boundary safely.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the structured reply metadata path and durable fallback delivery contract together.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this issue only after explicitly routing reply metadata to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 and fallback semantics to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Accept Markdown Reply As Enough
options.body: Close the reply portion as satisfied by the current Markdown quote affordance and leave no-output behavior solely to the fallback-delivery issue.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the structured reply metadata path and durable fallback delivery contract together.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history touches the Control UI send path, gateway protocol schema, and runtime context type involved in the contract boundary.
